items.text: Event Stream: Immutable, time-ordered log.
Event Fusion: 35:1 Compression of repetitive signals.
JIT Interpretation: Context-aware retrieval ("Driver" vs "Analyst").
Security: Ed25519 Response Signing.
Blind Store: Basic Zero-Knowledge encrypted payloads (ChaCha20).
Protocols: HTTP/2, WebSocket, UDP.
Raft Replication: Robust Leader Election and Log Replication.
Resilience: Retry logic and partitioned networking handling.
Persistence: WAL (Write-Ahead Log) for atomic state preservation.
State Machine: Direct linkage between Raft Log and INDB Kernel Ingest.
Immutable Audit: Merkle Tree-backed audit logs for tamper evidence.
RBAC: Role-Based Access Control enforcing Least Privilege.
Hardware Ops: (Deferred to v1.0)
Defense-in-Depth: Application-layer permission boundaries.
gRPC Streaming: IngestStream RPC for efficient chunked binary upload.
Binary Payload: Native support for bytes in Event model.
Refactoring: Decoupled JITRenderer from Core Storage for modular architecture.
Async Bridge: Standardized Async/Sync interop for Services.
Source Entity: First-class "Source" citizen with SourceType (Sensor, AI, Human, etc.).
Source Registry: Kernel-level registry for trusted agents and sensors.
Provenance: source_id linking for every Event to its origin.
Weighted Consensus: Using Source Reputation as gravity in Event Fusion.
Signature Chain: Cryptographic signing of events by Sources.
At-Rest Encryption: AES-256-GCM for indb.bin storage (upgraded from Fernet).
PBKDF2 Key Derivation: 100,000 iterations for master key.
TLS/SSL Transport: Self-signed certificate generation and Uvicorn SSL support.
Certificate Management: Automatic generation, validation, and renewal.
Zero External Databases: Removed pymongo/BSON, replaced with msgpack.
Autonomy Principle: NO Redis, NO PostgreSQL, NO MongoDB - pure binary storage.
TTL Cache: Time-to-live in-memory cache with LRU eviction.
Bloom Filters: Probabilistic duplicate detection (0.1% false positive rate).
Weak References: Memory-efficient object caching.
Query Cache: Automatic caching of expensive queries (5-10 min TTL).
Cache Statistics: Real-time hit/miss ratio monitoring.
MessagePack Protocol: Binary content negotiation (autonomous alternative to BSON).
Async Optimization: Convert all blocking I/O to async/await.
Memory-Mapped Storage: Fast binary access for large datasets.
Object Pooling: Reusable Event objects for reduced GC pressure.
LZ4 Compression: Optional storage compression.
Reality Guard Demo: Interactive Inhale-Exhale-Axiom visualization.
Comprehensive README: All startup commands for all components.
MkDocs Site: Full API reference and guides.
Type System Docs: Complete with binary type.
CHANGELOG: Complete release history.
Version Updates: All files updated to v1.0.0.
SDKs: Official Python, TypeScript, and Go clients.
CLI Improvements: Interactive mode, better error messages.
TUI Enhancements: Real-time metrics dashboard.
Load Testing: 100k events/sec benchmark.
Security Audit: Penetration testing and vulnerability scan.
Performance Profiling: Memory and CPU optimization.
Integration Tests: End-to-end protocol testing.
Docker Compose: Multi-node Raft cluster setup.
Prometheus Monitoring: Metrics collection configured.
Kubernetes Helm: Production-ready charts.
Grafana Dashboards: Visualization templates.
LTS: Long Term Support release with 2-year maintenance.
Embedding Engine: Automatic vector embeddings for events.
Semantic Search: Similarity-based retrieval.
Pattern Recognition: ML-based anomaly detection.
Predictive Fusion: AI-assisted deduplication.
Neural Interpreter: Context-aware event interpretation using transformers.
Plugin System: Custom interpreters and fusion algorithms.
Marketplace: Community-contributed extensions.
Federation: Cross-INDB instance queries.
GraphQL Federation: Distributed schema stitching.
Event Sourcing: CQRS pattern support.
